references.title: en.wiktionary: Ems
references.supports: Proper noun: the river, and the spa town on the Lahn, from the older form Embs

notes.rationale: und dann ebensolange Ems, then as long in Ems, the spa town Bad Ems, a place name with a Core gender (Neut, Rule de/proper-noun-article), 🏙 as any other city (Emoji Description conventions). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root ems and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
